prompt.value:
The numbers a, b, c, d have frequencies (x + 6), (x + 2), (x −3) and x respectively. If
their mean is m, ﬁnd the value of x.
Give an expression in the stated parameters.

explanation.value: The weighted-mean equation is m(4x+5)=x(a+b+c+d)+6a+2b−3c. Solve for x and round upward as requested.

prompt.value:
The mean and sample standard deviation of the dataset consisting of N observations
is m and s respectively. Later it is noted that one observation x is wrongly noted as p.
Based on the given information, answer questions (2) and (3).
What is the mean of the original dataset?
Give an expression in the stated parameters.

explanation.value: Replacing the incorrectly recorded p by x changes the total by x−p, so the corrected mean is m+(x−p)/N.

prompt.value:
The mean and sample standard deviation of the dataset consisting of N observations
is m and s respectively. Later it is noted that one observation x is wrongly noted as p.
Based on the given information, answer questions (2) and (3).
What is the sample variance of the original dataset?
Give an expression in the stated parameters.

explanation.value: The original sum of squared values is (N−1)s²+Nm². Replace p² by x², then subtract N times the square of the corrected mean and divide by N−1.

prompt.value: The observations x₁,x₂,…,xₙ are retail prices. How does the sample variance change if the same constant c is added to every observation?
State how the sample variance changes.

explanation.value: Adding the same constant to all observations leaves every deviation from the mean unchanged; therefore sample variance is unchanged.
